description:
“In a given circle to inscribe an equilateral and equiangular pentagon.”
— Euclid's Elements, BOOK IV • PROP. 11 (G.163)

00:00 1 · GIVEN: given circle ( A B C D E )
00:15 2 · CONSTRUCT: golden triangle ⟨ F G H ⟩ and equiangular inscribed ⟨ A C D ⟩
00:32 3 · CONSTRUCT: bisect ⟨ A C D ) by / C E /, ⟨ C D A ) by / D B /, join pentagon sides
00:49 4 · ASSERT: 5 equal inscribed angles → 5 equal arcs → pentagon ⟨ A B C D E ⟩ is equilateral
01:16 5 · ASSERT: ( A B C D ) = ( E D C B ) → all 5 pentagon angles are equal
01:44 6 · ∴: regular pentagon ⟨ A B C D E ⟩ is inscribed in ( A B C D E )
02:11 7 · COMMENTARY: the Pythagorean pentagram-star & Taylor's construction
